name: axolotl
summary: Use when configuring, running, or debugging LLM fine-tuning with Axolotl YAML, including LoRA/QLoRA, preference training, and distributed setups.

Ajoute le format de mon dataset à la config Axolotl stp
Axolotl supporte GRPO ? Comment lancer l’entraînement ?
